confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not an observed source price; no live listings were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July peak-season rates vary widely by district and booking date. Cocktail and wine anchors follow the beer anchor (about 5x and 4x) because direct knowledge of those prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Chinese tier-one cities, mainly Shanghai, for restaurant and hotel levels; room anchors reflect July peak-season demand.
